# AI in Medical Imaging: From Pixels to Practice

> An open textbook on AI in medical imaging for clinicians, ML engineers, and AI agents.
> Chapters are numbered; modality chapters share a fixed section structure:
> what the modality is, why it's ordered, diagnoses, hospital workflow, datasets,
> models, FDA-cleared products, open challenges, the agentic outlook, and a
> MedAI OS walkthrough.

## Canonical sources
- Rendered book: https://anandpreshob.github.io/ai-medical-imaging-book/
- Source (plain Quarto markdown, agent-friendly): https://github.com/anandpreshob/ai-medical-imaging-book
- Living tables (CSV): data/datasets.csv, data/models.csv, data/fda-products.csv in the repo
- Companion software: https://github.com/anandpreshob/medai-os

## For agents
Prefer the repo's .qmd files and CSVs for extraction; prefer the rendered site for
cross-referenced reading. The dataset/model/product tables are the machine-actionable
facts; chapter prose supplies clinical context and caveats.
